value.answer: Call 911 now. Fever with purple spots that do not fade when pressed needs emergency care right away, even if your child seems okay. Don't wait to see if it spreads.
value.triage: Call 911 now - do not wait for a callback from 811, this is not a nurse-line situation. Tell the operator if your child is floppy, very drowsy, breathing fast, or has cold hands and feet.
